title: fix(app-shell): the pending-drafts bar's sentence wraps on a phone instead of being cut (objectui#13088)
body:
Fixes #13088

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`PendingDraftsBar` drew its sentence in a `min-w-0 truncate` span: one line, `overflow: hidden`, an ellipsis. On a phone the bar's row is narrower than the sentence, so the half that says users cannot see the change was cut (zh at 390 px ended 「用户还看不…」).

The span is now `min-w-0 flex-1`: it takes the row's free width and wraps. The publish button keeps `shrink-0`, so it keeps its width on the bar. The span gains `data-testid="pending-drafts-bar-sentence"` so the structural test finds it without reading the classes it asserts about. The bar's own row classes are unchanged (`items-center` kept, see H5 below).

Only `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/PendingDraftsBar.tsx` changes in source (one class string, one attribute, one comment). No prop, export or published face moves: the diff neither widens nor narrows any export or prop (`Clause-②: no`, as the claim declared). The i18n key `console.ai.pendingDrafts.count` and its values are untouched. The bar's mount in `AiChatPage.tsx`, the preview pill and `packages/plugin-chatbot/**` are untouched.

## Measured boxes (Acceptance 1)

Chromium headless, the rig of PR #13067 / PR #13085 reused: the worktree's console Vite dev server serving the REAL full-page `AiChatPage` (or the REAL `ChatDockMobileSheet` / `ChatDockPanel`), with `fetch` stubbed in the page (one `build` agent, two turns plus an `apply_blueprint` result, one draft in the ledger). One addition to the harness: a `lang=zh|en` switch on the `I18nProvider`. "Before" is `main` `cd4623d` as checked out (nothing edited); "after" is `d45156b`. Boxes are left top right bottom, CSS px. Viewports: 390 by 844, 320 by 700, 1010 by 800, 1280 by 900.

**Control:** `before-fullpage-390-zh` reads the card's numbers exactly: sentence `scrollWidth` 248 against `clientWidth` 240, bar 16 650 374 704; at 320 px, 248 against 170.

At desktop widths the span's `scrollWidth` grows only because `flex-1` now lets it fill the row; the text stays on one line and the bar, button and textarea boxes are identical before and after. In every reading the button sits inside the bar and on screen, a tap at its centre reaches it, and the page has no horizontal scroll (`scrollWidth` equals the viewport width).

**Where the evidence lives:** commit `4d0b7e0` of this branch, directory `evidence/13088/`: every reading as JSON (before and after), the bar crops and full-page screenshots above plus the desktop-dock en crops, a README, the throwaway harness page and the Playwright driver. The next commit, `5dc6838`, deletes the directory, so this pull request's diff does not carry it (`git rev-parse d45156b^{tree} 5dc6838^{tree}` prints the same tree twice). No other branch was created.

### The PM's hypotheses, measured

- **H1 confirmed.** The single producer is the span's `truncate` (computed `white-space: nowrap`, `text-overflow: ellipsis` before; `normal` / `clip` after). With the clamp gone the sentence is whole at 390 and 320 px in zh and en, on two lines (three for en at 320), and the button stays on the bar.
- **H2 confirmed.** zh breaks between characters and en at spaces with no `break-words`; no `break-all` was added. At zh 390 the second line holds 「到。」 alone. `text-pretty` was tried and measured: the same boxes, it moved one character at 390 and split 「用户」 at 320, so it was not kept.
- **H3 confirmed.** The test reads structure, finds the sentence by its `data-testid`, and goes red with the clamp restored (below).
- **H4 confirmed.** The bar grows upward only: its bottom edge stays put in every phone reading (704, 560, 696, 552) and its top rises 4 px for two lines or 24 px for three. The textarea's box does not move, and bar on textarea is 0 at 390 and 320 px in zh and en, in the full page and the dock sheet. With the pill showing, the pill rises by the same 4 or 24 px and stays clear of the bar. `AiChatPage.draftsBarInFlow-12978.test.tsx` and `AiChatPage.previewPillInFlow-13068.test.tsx` are untouched and green.
- **H5: `items-center` kept.** The button is centred against the wrapped sentence (11 px above and below it in the 58 px zh 390 bar, 21 and 21 in the 78 px en 320 bar), fully inside the bar, on screen, and reachable by a tap at its centre. `items-start` would pin it to the first line and leave an empty band under it beside a three-line sentence, so the row's alignment does not change.
- **H6 confirmed** for the full page at 1010 and 1280: one line, boxes identical. One new fact: the desktop dock (a 420 px column) cut the en sentence as well (386 against 281). The same change wraps it there onto two lines, the bar 4 px taller, upward.

## Tests (Acceptance 2)

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/PendingDraftsBar.sentenceWraps-13088.test.tsx` (new). The real `PendingDraftsBar` with one pending draft. happy-dom runs no layout and loads no stylesheet, so it reads the structure that decides whether the sentence can wrap: the sentence element (by `data-testid`) holds the whole sentence and carries no one-line clamp (`truncate`, `whitespace-nowrap`, `text-nowrap`, `text-ellipsis`, `overflow-hidden`, `overflow-x-hidden`, `overflow-clip`, `line-clamp-*`); nothing from it up to the bar hands it `white-space: nowrap` by inheritance (`truncate`, `whitespace-nowrap`, `text-nowrap`); the publish button is on the same bar.
- **Ablation 1:** fix committed, then the sentence's class put back to `min-w-0 truncate` with its `data-testid` kept (`ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0 on disk, blob `f409ec4` to `b843724`). The new test went red, `Tests 1 failed (1)`, on `expected [ 'truncate' ] to deeply equal []`. Restored: blob equals HEAD (`f409ec4`) and `git diff HEAD` empty. Reverting the whole file to `main` also turns it red, but on the missing handle, which is why the class-only leg is the one recorded.
- **Mutation 2:** `whitespace-nowrap` added to the bar's row, the sentence untouched. Red, `Tests 1 failed (1)`, on `expected [ 'div whitespace-nowrap' ] to deeply equal []`, the inherited-clamp reading. Restored and proved the same way.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the new test plus `PendingDraftsBar.test.tsx`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 3 passed (3)`.
- The whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite on head `5dc6838` (`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, which is `vitest run --root ../.. packages/app-shell/`): `Test Files 1613 passed | 1 skipped (1614)`, `Tests 15041 passed | 9 skipped (15050)`, exit 0. It includes `AiChatPage.draftsBarInFlow-12978.test.tsx`, `AiChatPage.previewPillInFlow-13068.test.tsx` and `PendingDraftsBar.advisoryReachesAuthor.test.tsx`, all untouched.

## Gates (local subset; the farm is CI's)

Each exit code was captured to a file before any pipe, on head `5dc6838` (tree `eeb2438`, the same tree as `d45156b`).

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: exit 0 (`0 errors`, warnings only; none in the changed files).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0, after building the package's dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 28 tasks successful). `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so the new test is compiled.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`: exit 0 (`Test Files 1613 passed | 1 skipped (1614)`); about 60 minutes on the shared four-core box, under the shared verify lock.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` 0 (`0 new citation(s)`), `pnpm check:control-bytes` 0, `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers` 0, `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit` 0, `pnpm check:vi-mock-override-shape` 0, `pnpm check:test-path-roots` 0, `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources` 0, `pnpm check:changeset-claims` 0, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0 (`2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`), `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 0.
- Changeset: `.changeset/13088-drafts-bar-sentence-wraps.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- The component's header comment still says the bar "floats above the composer"; since PR #13067 it is a row in flow above the input. A comment only, left as it is here (no carrier).
- The desktop dock's en reading is a second place the same `truncate` cut the sentence; it is covered by this change, not a separate defect.
